offers.brand: Wreath-Laying Ceremony and Observance, Memorial Park
offers.offer: The Pikes Peak Veterans Council and Special Forces Association Chapter 4-24 hold the public Veterans Day wreath-laying and observance at 11 AM, with Mayor Yemi Mobolade and others speaking. Free and open to all.
offers.limits: Lasts about an hour. Bring a chair. Held rain or shine. The exact spot inside the park is the monuments garden (KRDO); the pin is at the park's Pikes Peak Ave edge.
offers.notes: The Pikes Peak Veterans Council and Special Forces Association Chapter 4-24 hold the city's Veterans Day wreath-laying and observance at 11 AM in the monuments garden at Memorial Park, with Mayor Yemi Mobolade and others speaking. About an hour, rain or shine; bring a chair. Free and open to all (The Gazette, 10 Nov 2026; KRDO, 1 Sep 2026). 1605 E Pikes Peak Ave.

offers.brand: Tri-Lakes Post 9-11 Veterans Day memorial, Crawford Memorial, Palmer Lake

offers.limits: End time, street address and who may attend are not published; The Gazette lists it among the area's public events. The pin is OpenStreetMap's William J. Crawford Memorial.
offers.notes: American Legion Tri-Lakes Post 9-11 holds its Veterans Day memorial at 10 AM at the MSG William J. Crawford Memorial in Palmer Lake, by the Palmer Lake Regional Recreation Area (The Gazette, 10 Nov 2026). No street address or end time is published.

offers.brand: Pikes Peak State College Veterans Day wreath-laying, Centennial Campus
offers.offer: Pikes Peak State College's 11 AM wreath-laying ceremony at the Centennial Campus Veterans Memorial Courtyard, part of its Veterans Week (9-13 Nov). Free.
offers.limits: The college's page doesn't say whether the public may attend; ask its Military & Veteran Programs office, mvp@pikespeak.edu or 719-502-4100. End time not published.
offers.notes: Pikes Peak State College's Veterans Day wreath-laying at 11 AM in the Veterans Memorial Courtyard, Centennial Campus, during its Veterans Week; Field of Flags at every campus 6-16 Nov (the college's own page; The Gazette, 10 Nov 2026). 5675 S Academy Blvd.
offers.caution: The college doesn't say whether the public may attend: ask its MVP office (mvp@pikespeak.edu, 719-502-4100)

other.name: Pikes Peak Highway: free admission for military
other.where: Pikes Peak Highway, Cascade (west of Colorado Springs, off US 24)
other.offer: Free admission on 11 Nov for active and retired military with ID, weather permitting. Check road status before driving up.
other.note: The city's 9 Nov 2026 closures page names active and retired military. The city's older Veterans Day discount page (undated, "Monday, Nov. 11", so a past year) says "all that have served", which would include veterans; it couldn't be opened here, so call before relying on it as a veteran not retired. Veterans with no military ID should bring a DD-214 or VA card.

other.name: Colorado state parks: free entry for veterans, active duty and Guard
other.where: Every Colorado Parks and Wildlife state park, for example Cheyenne Mountain State Park in Colorado Springs
other.offer: Free park entry for veterans, active-duty military and National Guard members with proof (DD-214, DD Form 2, DD Form 2765, a military ID, a Colorado license or state ID marked Veteran, or a VA medical card). Camping, fishing and other fees still apply.
other.note: CPW's page says both "registration is required" and "no registration required": check before you go. KRDO (6 Nov 2026) says everyone in the vehicle gets in (not on CPW's page; not checked).

other.name: National parks: fee-free day for US residents
other.where: Every National Park Service site that charges entrance; the nearest to Colorado Springs is Florissant Fossil Beds National Monument in Teller County
other.offer: Entrance fees are waived on Veterans Day for US citizens and residents only (nonresidents pay). Timed-entry, reservation, camping and other fees still apply.
other.note: Veterans, Gold Star families and active military also get a free lifetime Military Pass for federal recreation sites, good any day.

other.name: National forests: day-use fees waived for everyone
other.where: Forest Service lands, including Pike National Forest around Colorado Springs, Woodland Park and Monument
other.offer: The Forest Service lists Veterans Day, 11 Nov 2026, as a fee-free day: recreation fees waived at most day-use sites. Camping and concession sites aren't covered, and concessions may vary.
other.note: The page carries no date of its own. Pike National Forest's own notice wasn't read.

other.name: Salute from the Springs: 1,111 flags downtown
other.where: Downtown Colorado Springs, in the street medians along the parade area (2026 streets not published; in 2025 S Cascade Ave and N and S Nevada Ave)
other.offer: 1,111 American flags, each in the name of a veteran or service member, from 1 Nov through Veterans Day. Free to walk or drive past.
other.note: Not routed, because no flag site is published for 2026. The In Their Honor parade ran Sat 7 Nov.

sources.publisher: In Their Honor Veterans Day Parade

other.day: Wed 11 Nov, 11:00 AM, 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM MST
other.name: Air Force Academy Planetarium: free showings of America the Beautiful
other.where: U.S. Air Force Academy (on base; needs base access)
other.offer: Free screenings of the documentary "America the Beautiful" at 11 AM, 1 PM and 3 PM, first come, first served. Visitors not tied to the Defense Department, or not with someone who is, must request a base-access pass through the Academy's website.
other.note: The Gazette gives no address; the planetarium's own page wasn't found.

other.day: Wed 11 Nov, 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM MST
other.name: Air Force basketball Veterans Day doubleheader
other.where: Clune Arena, U.S. Air Force Academy (on base; needs base access)
other.offer: Men host Loyola (Ill.) at 1 PM and women host San Francisco at 4 PM. No Veterans Day ticket offer was found.

other.name: UCCS Cops & Vets Mile Walk
other.where: University of Colorado Colorado Springs (location not published for 2026; the 2025 walk started at the West Lawn)
other.offer: UCCS Veteran & Military Affairs and campus police hold a mile walk at 11 AM during Veterans Week (9-13 Nov); a Veterans Week Luncheon follows Thu 12 Nov in Berger Hall.
other.note: The Gazette (10 Nov 2026) doesn't say where or who may join; UCCS's 2025 listing was for students and alumni. Not routable: call UCCS Veteran & Military Affairs, 719-255-8227.

other.name: American Legion Post 38: Veterans Day ceremony, Fountain
other.where: 6685 Southmoor Dr, Fountain, CO (about 6.3 km from the South side circle's center, just outside)
other.offer: The post's Veterans Day ceremony at 11 AM.
other.note: The Gazette doesn't say who may attend. Fountain is south of Fort Carson.

other.name: The Classical Academy: Veterans Day assembly
other.where: North Campus gym, The Classical Academy North Campus, 975 Stout Rd, Colorado Springs
other.offer: A student-led assembly open to veterans, military families and the community, with retired Air Force JAG officer Timothy M. Goines speaking.
other.note: The street address is from OpenStreetMap and the Census geocoder, not the Gazette.

other.name: Jenkins Middle School: memorial bench dedication
other.where: Francis L. Jenkins Middle School, 6410 Austin Bluffs Pkwy, Colorado Springs
other.offer: Dedication of a memorial bench and commemorative rocks for veterans (an Eagle Scout project), 2:15 PM; a reception for veterans at 2:30 and a student, staff and guest assembly at 2:45.
other.note: A school event; the Gazette doesn't say it is open to the public. Call the school first.

other.name: School Veterans Day programs: Fremont Elementary, Cheyenne Mountain High and others
other.where: Fremont Elementary (8:10-8:50 AM gym assembly, veterans, active duty and family only, RSVP required); Cheyenne Mountain High School's morning gym program; Broadmoor and Gold Camp elementaries' assemblies
other.offer: District 11 and District 12 schools hold assemblies for veterans and their families; times are given only for Fremont.

other.name: Woodland Park Jr/Sr High: Veterans Day assembly, breakfast and celebration
other.where: Woodland Park Junior/Senior High School, Woodland Park (Teller County, west on US 24)
other.offer: A Veterans Day breakfast and celebration open to the public, with refreshments after the 1:30 PM assembly.

other.name: Teller County Veterans Day dinner
other.where: Shining Mountain Golf Course, Woodland Park
other.offer: A Veterans Day dinner at 5 PM with a formal ceremony at 5:30.
other.note: The Gazette (10 Nov 2026) doesn't give a price or the host. In 2025 Teller County hosted a free dinner for veterans and families at the Ute Pass Cultural Center, 4-7 PM (KOAA, Nov 2025): confirm before assuming it is free this year.

other.name: U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Museum: 20% off for veterans in November
other.where: 200 S Sierra Madre St, Colorado Springs, 719-497-1234
other.offer: Veterans get 20% off admission throughout November 2026, including the 12 PM Valor to Victory tour (60 minutes, daily). The museum is closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays, so not on Veterans Day itself.
other.note: From the museum's own November post (5 Nov 2026), which doesn't name the proof. Its older pages (Veterans Day 2024: 50% off) are out of date.

leads.name: Red Leg Brewing Company (veteran-owned)
leads.area: 2323 Garden of the Gods Rd, Colorado Springs, (719) 598-3776
leads.offer: Its Veterans Day Tribute Wall (photos and notes in the taproom) ran from Veterans Day to 12 Dec in 2025, and a Veterans Mug Club raffle ($5 flagship pours) drew winners on Veterans Day. Its own event calendar, read 11 Nov 2026, lists no Veterans Day event in November 2026 (trivia at 6:30 PM on the 11th).

source.publisher: Red Leg Brewing Company (2025 event page)

leads.name: Jack Quinn's Irish Pub
leads.q: Jack Quinn's Irish Pub Colorado Springs veterans
leads.offer: KOAA's undated roundup: 15% off food for veterans any day, and a free pint on a past Veterans Day (it names a Saturday, so not 2026). The pub's own site (11 Nov 2026) shows nothing for veterans; open 11 AM-10 PM Wednesdays.

leads.name: Lost Friend Brewing (veteran-owned)
leads.offer: No 2026 Veterans Day offer found; its home page lists none (open 11 AM-9 PM Wednesdays).

leads.name: Phantom Canyon Brewing
leads.area: 2 E Pikes Peak Ave, Colorado Springs
leads.offer: The lead report's Thursday Military Night, 20% off for military and veterans (so Thu 12 Nov), came from an Untappd listing and couldn't be confirmed; the brewery's home page doesn't mention it. In 2024 it planned to give 10% of sales to the Torchlight Initiative on Veterans Day (The Gazette, 12 Nov 2024).

leads.name: The Melting Pot
leads.area: 30 E Pikes Peak Ave, Ste A, Colorado Springs, (719) 385-0300
leads.q: Melting Pot Colorado Springs Veterans Day military
leads.offer: 30% off with a military ID after 4 PM on 11 Nov 2015 (The Gazette's list, last updated Oct 2026, offers from 2015). The restaurant's own page (11 Nov 2026) has no veterans offer; open 4-9 PM Wednesday.

leads.name: National Museum of World War II Aviation
leads.q: National Museum of WWII Aviation Veterans Day
leads.offer: Open Wed 10 AM-5 PM. No Veterans Day offer on its page. Standing rates: military $13-15 (the page gives two sets of prices), WWII veterans free. Its next event is a talk on Sat 14 Nov. The Gazette's military calendar prints the address as 755.

source.publisher: National Museum of World War II Aviation

leads.name: Cheyenne Mountain Zoo
leads.area: 4250 Cheyenne Mountain Zoo Rd, Colorado Springs
leads.offer: No Veterans Day offer. Its Military Appreciation Week is 50% off base admission with military ID, a DD-214, a veteran-marked license, a VA, VFW or Legion ID or (spouse) a military spouse ID; its page says "2027 dates TBA".

leads.name: Space Foundation Discovery Center
leads.q: Space Foundation Discovery Center Military Appreciation Day
leads.offer: Closed for renovation, reopening January 2027 (its own page). Its Military Appreciation Day was Sat 8 Nov 2025, free for veterans, military and families.

leads.name: Western Museum of Mining & Industry
leads.q: Western Museum of Mining Industry Veterans Day free admission
leads.offer: Open that Wednesday for a homeschool class (1-2:30 PM). Its November 2026 calendar has no veterans offer; free veterans admission appeared on its 2022 and 2024 calendars.

source.publisher: Western Museum of Mining & Industry (Nov 2026 calendar)

leads.name: Pikes Peak Cog Railway, Manitou Cliff Dwellings, ProRodeo Hall of Fame, Colorado Springs Fine Arts Center
leads.q: Pikes Peak Cog Railway Manitou Cliff Dwellings ProRodeo Fine Arts Center Veterans Day 2026
leads.offer: No 2026 Veterans Day offer found for any of the four (a Cliff Dwellings coupon listing expired 12/31/2025).

leads.name: ANA Money Museum
leads.q: ANA Money Museum veterans free admission
leads.offer: Its Purple Heart exhibit ran at Veterans Day 2025, and a 2024 listing gave free entry to veterans, active duty and families. Nothing found for 2026.

leads.name: 3 Hundred Days Distilling
leads.offer: 10% off for veterans, with no date or holiday tied to it (VisitCOS's veteran-owned business page, undated). Not a Veterans Day offer.

leads.name: Teller County Veterans Day dinner
leads.area: Ute Pass Cultural Center, 210 E Midland Ave, Woodland Park
leads.q: Teller County Veterans Day dinner free
leads.offer: In 2025: a free dinner for veterans and families, 4-7 PM, ceremony at 5 PM. The 2026 dinner is at Shining Mountain Golf Course at 5 PM (The Gazette); price not stated.

leads.name: Hoedown for Heroes (Mt. Carmel Veterans Service Center)
leads.offer: A ticketed gala (Fri 14 Nov 2025, 5:30 PM, tickets listed at $200). No 2026 date found.
